mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the modifications of the body of knowledge of people and their tools."
Cultural change is the modifications of the body of knowledge of people and their tools.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of communication is faster and attends to a large number of people irrespective of distance almost simultaneously."
Modern means of communication is faster and attends to a large number of people irrespective of distance almost simultaneously.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the name under which sociologists study inequality in society, that is, the unequal distribution of goods and services, rights and obligations, power and prestige. (Littlejohn, 1972:9)."

Social structure or social stratification is the name under which sociologists study inequality in society, that is, the unequal distribution of goods and services, rights and obligations, power and prestige. (Littlejohn, 1972:9).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the common newspaper that is found in Nigeria."
Tabloid is the common newspaper that is found in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the focal point of human existence and therefore the media practitioners should understand the economic variables of their society."
The economy is the focal point of human existence and therefore the media practitioners should understand the economic variables of their society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned about the role of government and the private sector in the economy."
The public is concerned about the role of government and the private sector in the economy.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the family, school, peer group, church/mosque and the mass media."
The agents of socialization are the family, school, peer group, church/mosque and the mass media.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the last but important part of the communication process."
Feedback is the last but important part of the communication process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system of communication whereby information is disseminated through local channels of communication to members of the society."
Traditional communication is a system of communication whereby information is disseminated through local channels of communication to members of the society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the decoder of the message."
The receiver is the decoder of the message.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a chain-link of equipment used for sending out or receiving electronic microwaves or signals."
Satellite - A satellite is a chain-link of equipment used for sending out or receiving electronic microwaves or signals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the oldest medium of mass communication whereas the newspapers are the first popular mass medium."
Books are the oldest medium of mass communication whereas the newspapers are the first popular mass medium.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most powerful in the world today for affecting the minds, emotions and even the actions of mankind."
The broadcast media are the most powerful in the world today for affecting the minds, emotions and even the actions of mankind.
